race.comment: THERE GOES MY HERO (7) has the profile to peak now after two fourths over 1210m at this track, the latest in BM64 company when he picked up nicely late on soft ground. He gets weight relief, is third-up and has previous placings at this track and distance. Bold showing anticipated. OR AM I (12) is the immediate danger after launching home to just miss here last start. She does rise in standard, but her recent form is trending the right way. RAIKOKE (2) is also ticking along nicely and the apprentice claim helps keep him right in the contest. CHEF MILITAIRE (1) keeps winning an is impossible to leave out of the numbers. Stone sticking with her 3kg claim helps big time.
